topic: Reviewing frequency calculation changes and rollbacks
summary_markdown:
The conversation addressed an increase in frequency observed in Brazil and other virtual box locations. A discussion ensued regarding rolling back recent changes, particularly the new formula developed by Vlad that is currently on stage.

It was clarified that the Brazilian client does not rely on standard frequency metrics; they use a synthetic metric, and their numbers were frozen pending approval from their side.

Concerns remain about whether the current proposed changes will affect historical frequency data or real-time calculations, necessitating a review of potential impacts.
decisions: The new formula (Vlad's) currently on stage needs to be rolled back.
action_items: Review the impact of current changes on historical and real-time frequency data for Brazil/virtual boxes.
